prompt_section: ## 4. CHARACTER C — System Analyst — exact final prompt
prompt_suffix: IDENTITY — the SAME approved person shown in reference #1 (System Analyst master); preserve exactly, do NOT redesign: same face, shoulder-length dark-brown hair in a LOW BUN (#3A2B22), slim glasses, medium skin (#E8B48C), light blouse under a soft cardigan with subtle PURPLE accent (#A98BFF), tailored trousers, flats, slightly shorter slimmer build, thoughtful organized professional. She must remain the SAME recognizable character — only the POSE changes. STATE = REVIEWING: standing and reviewing a tablet/documents held in her hands, focused on a process or architecture design, a work-oriented attentive posture, slightly turned toward the workstation. CAMERA: true 3/4 top-down ISOMETRIC, body turned about 30-45 degrees, slight top-down, feet aligned to the isometric floor direction — not front-facing, not profile, not a flat sticker. STYLE: the SAME fine pixel density, thin selective outlines, 3-tone shading and soft ambient occlusion as the IT/Dev floor (reference #2). LIGHTING: warm key light from the upper-left, softer darker shading lower-right, a subtle cyan monitor rim light, gentle ambient occlusion. Standalone single character, fully TRANSPARENT background — NO room, floor, desk, chair, shadow plate, scenery, UI, text, logo or watermark; full body with nothing cropped. REFERENCE PRIORITY: #1 approved character master controls IDENTITY and must be preserved exactly; #2 IT/Dev floor controls perspective, pixel density and lighting; #3 original office image controls the general game-art direction.
